name: sellora-supabase
description: Sellora's Supabase project: schema, Edge Functions, their tests, and admin scripts.

scripts.test: node tests/rls.test.mjs && node --test scripts/ && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:functions: cd functions && deno test --config deno.json --allow-env --allow-read tests/
scripts.check:functions: cd functions && deno check --config deno.json api/index.ts
scripts.serve: npx supabase functions serve api --env-file functions/.env
